description: This file defines a Playwright tool for filling out form fields within a browser tab, including schema validation, locator resolution, and handling different input types (textboxes, checkboxes, radio buttons, comboboxes, sliders). It exports a single tool configuration used within the Playwright code generation framework.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles filling form fields in the browser tab based on the schema and input parameters, supporting different input types and generating corresponding code snippets.
